expectations.text: Explicitly states simultaneous same-turn spawn strategy, not sequential
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'I would spawn the with_skill and baseline runs simultaneously in the same turn, not sequentially.'

expectations.text: Describes timing data as unrecoverable and captures it immediately on run completion
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'Timing data capture is immediate and unrecoverable: the completion notification's total_tokens and duration_ms are only available at completion time. If I fail to record them immediately, I cannot reconstruct them later.'

expectations.text: Describes drafting assertions while runs are in progress
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'While the simultaneous runs are in progress, I would not sit idle... I would use that time to draft quantitative assertions for each eval and explain them to the user.'
